  - Residency: all logs and tokens must live within their NOC; retention policy configurable per-route.
  - Compatible models: prefer open quantized models; explicit ask to support quantization + model distillation.

- Commercial / pricing:

  - Interested in Redwood Optimize package for batching/quantization recommendations to drive down unit cost.
